url.description: Original input SaaS/cloud URL or bare domain requested for auditing.

normalizedInputUrl.description: Normalized HTTP/HTTPS URL derived from input.

finalUrl.description: Resolved homepage URL after validated HTTP redirects.

status.description: Audit execution status (audited, blocked_ssrf, blocked_robots, error).

sitePlatform.description: Detected web/docs platform (nextjs, webflow, framer, wordpress, docusaurus, mintlify, shopify, custom).

siteCategory.description: Classified domain category (b2b_or_b2c_saas, cloud_or_api_infra, ai_or_data_platform, ecommerce_or_marketplace, brochure_or_content).

loadTimeMs.description: Total domain audit duration in milliseconds.

pagesFetchedCount.description: Total HTML pages fetched for this domain (homepage + discovered internal legal/pricing/trust/docs subpages).

pagesFetched.description: URLs of all HTML pages inspected on this domain.

errorMessage.description: Diagnostic error or security block reason when status is not audited.

isSaasOrCloudServiceDetected.description: Whether EU Data Act Art. 2(8) data processing service (SaaS/PaaS/IaaS/Cloud API/AI) SDKs or structural signals were detected.

complianceScore.description: Deterministic 0-100 EU Data Act Chapter VI & DORA SaaS switching compliance score (100 = no heuristic issues detected; 0 is returned on non-audited error/blocked rows where status !== "audited").

riskTier.description: Heuristic compliance risk tier: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.

billingSdkVendors.description: Detected billing & subscription SDKs (stripe-billing, paddle, chargebee, recurly, lemon-squeezy, zuora, fastspring, braintree).

authIdentityVendors.description: Detected auth & B2B SSO identity SDKs (auth0, clerk, workos, okta, stytch, supabase-auth, firebase-auth, cognito).

trustCenterGrcVendors.description: Detected Trust Center & GRC platforms (vanta, drata, safebase, conveyor, whistic, onetrust, secureframe, sprinto).

docsStatusSupportVendors.description: Detected developer docs, status & support markers (statuspage, betterstack, instatus, swagger-openapi, mintlify, readme-io, gitbook, docusaurus, intercom, zendesk, crisp, hubspot).

saasApplicabilitySignals.description: Matched SaaS/cloud applicability signals (SDK fingerprints, app login/console links, subscription tiers, API/cloud terms).

egressOrSwitchingFeeFound.description: Whether explicit data egress, switching, offboarding, or data-extraction charges were detected without an Art. 29(1) €0 switching carve-out.

exportPaywallOrTierLockFound.description: Whether CSV/JSON/API bulk data export is gated behind higher or Enterprise-only plans in conflict with Art. 30(2) & Art. 29(1).

egressAndExportInterfaceCheck.description: Detailed EU Data Act Art. 29(1) Jan 12, 2027 €0 egress/switching cliff & Art. 30(2) free open-interface analysis.

shortPostTerminationRetentionFound.description: Whether Terms state customer data is deleted immediately or in <30 calendar days upon termination/cancellation (violating Art. 25(2)(g)).

excessiveNoticePeriodLockInFound.description: Whether Terms require >2 months (e.g. 90 days) prior written notice to initiate switching/termination without an Art. 25(2)(d) override.

switchingAddendumFound.description: Whether an EU Data Act Chapter VI Cloud/SaaS Switching Addendum (Art. 25 ≤2-month notice, ≤30-day transition, ≥30-day retrieval) was found.

art25SwitchingContractCheck.description: Detailed EU Data Act Art. 25(1)-(5) mandatory written switching contract clauses & Recommendation (EU) 2026/2394 analysis.

art26bOnlinePortabilityRegisterFound.description: Whether an Art. 26(b) provider-hosted online register detailing exportable data structures, formats (JSON/CSV/OpenAPI), and interoperability specs was found.

art28IctJurisdictionDisclosed.description: Whether Art. 28(1)(a) ICT infrastructure hosting jurisdiction is publicly disclosed on the website.

art28NonPersonalGovAccessSafeguardsDiscl.description: Whether Art. 28(1)(b) & Art. 32 technical, organisational, and contractual safeguards against unlawful foreign governmental access to non-personal EU data are disclosed.

art26bAndArt28TransparencyCheck.description: Detailed EU Data Act Art. 26(b) Online Portability Register and Art. 28(1)/32 ICT Jurisdiction & Non-Personal Gov-Access transparency analysis.

nonCancellableFixedTermFound.description: Whether fixed-term annual/multi-year non-cancellable or no-refund commitment language was detected.

art29EarlyTerminationAndDoraExitGapFound.description: Whether fixed-term or enterprise/financial SaaS signals lack clear Art. 29(4) early-termination methodology or EU DORA Art. 30(2)(h) exit-strategy support.

art29TerminationAndDoraExitCheck.description: Detailed EU Data Act Art. 29(4) fixed-term early-termination transparency & EU DORA (Reg. 2022/2554 Art. 28(8) / Art. 30(2)(h)) exit-strategy analysis.

dataActAddendumUrl.description: Discovered EU Data Act / Cloud Switching Addendum URL.

portabilityRegisterUrl.description: Discovered Art. 26(b) Online Portability Register / Export Schema Docs URL.

trustOrJurisdictionUrl.description: Discovered Trust Center, Security, Subprocessors, or Art. 28 Jurisdiction URL.

pricingOrPlansUrl.description: Discovered SaaS Pricing or Plans URL.

termsOrMsaUrl.description: Discovered Terms of Service, MSA, or DPA URL.

discoveredLinks.description: Structured Data Act addendum, Art. 26(b) register, Trust/Art. 28 jurisdiction, pricing, and Terms/MSA URLs discovered on the domain.

findingsCount.description: Total number of EU Data Act & DORA compliance findings flagged.

findings.description: Prioritized technical compliance findings with ruleId, regulation, severity, evidence, and recommendation.

coldOutreachHook.description: Neutral, factual 1-2 sentence B2B outreach observation tailored for EU Data Act Legal, GRC/Trust-Center, and Cloud Migration consultancies.

remediationPackGenerated.description: Whether an EU Data Act Switching Addendum + Art. 26(b)/28 Register + /pricing €0 Egress Widget HTML/JS pack was generated.

recommendedNextAudits.description: Recommended follow-up Apify Actors across the 6-Actor US/UK/EU/ADA/Privacy/Cloud Compliance Suite.

overview.title: EU Data Act SaaS Switching & Zero-Egress Overview
